results.kind: Independently authored source-informed overlap route; implementer controls read but not imported. Not fresh play, optimum, or enjoyment.

finalGoals.title: A working sheltered bed
finalGoals.requirement: A watered rootbed under an actually supported clear roof, receiving useful light.

finalGoals.title: A useful soft interface
finalGoals.requirement: A moldable fitted porous surface actually supplied water to a growing bed. Any player-chosen surface may do this.

finalGoals.title: Keep the water service
finalGoals.requirement: A currently rigid porous fitted surface actually supplies a currently growing bed; replacement is legal.

finalGoals.title: Useful survey
finalGoals.requirement: Make actual front-on records of beacon and far-marker. They need not share a center on this board.

finalGoals.title: Readable working reference
finalGoals.requirement: A genuine physical observation copy is readable at the dry working bench. Temporary porous material is sufficient; durable alternatives remain legal.

finalGoals.title: Durable reference
finalGoals.requirement: A genuine physical observation copy remains readable in actual wet contact at the wet-display mount; durable watertight local material protects it. Geometrical copies do not create records.

finalGoals.title: Worked surface, new purpose
finalGoals.requirement: An actual surface that earlier supplied useful water while moldable now is durable/watertight and carries a genuine physical observation copy. A replacement can keep the water service.

finalGoals.title: Useful specimen holder
finalGoals.requirement: An actual table-leaf contact sample rests in a supported tray under overhead dust protection with light and open-side air.

finalGoals.title: Keep an actual relief
finalGoals.requirement: A durable watertight surface retains a real leaf-relief contact impression.

finalGoals.title: Publish the survey
finalGoals.requirement: Relay actual front-on beacon and far-marker records to the receiver.

finalGoals.title: Keep a useful conservatory
finalGoals.requirement: At endpoint a watered rootbed has supported clear overhead protection and useful light; original or replacement is valid.

finalGoals.title: Open public approach
finalGoals.requirement: The disclosed public path has no solid body or physical panel cutting its interior; no required garden square.

finalGoals.title: Common-center comparison
finalGoals.requirement: Actual front-on images of A and B from the same lens center establish their perpendicular bearing relationship. One camera or sequential cameras are equally valid.

finalGoals.title: Publish the comparison
finalGoals.requirement: Relay actual A and B records made from their same optical center to the receiver.

finalGoals.title: Conservatory specimen work
finalGoals.requirement: An actual garden-leaf contact sample rests in a supported lit tray under overhead dust protection with open-side air. Sharing an assembly is legal.

finalGoals.title: Keep a durable survey
finalGoals.requirement: A physical copy of an actual common-center survey observation remains readable in actual wet contact at the wet-display mount; durable watertight local material protects it.
